parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability (CWE-78: OS Command Injection) does not apply to the given code fragment. The code does not show how `int_type->name` is populated, but it is used in a `printf` statement, which does not involve any command execution.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code does not involve any command execution. The `printf` function is used to print the name and range of the constrained integer type, but it does not execute any commands. Therefore, even if `int_type->name` contains malicious input, it cannot lead to OS command injection.
